run_raw_image_publisher: run the SpotLocalRawImagesPublisher to publish head depth, hand depth, and hand RGB images to ROS topics
run_compressed_image_publisher: run the SpotLocalCompressedImagesPublisher to compress and publish robot camera images using blosc and JPEG encoding
run_depth_filter_publisher: run the SpotFilteredHeadDepthImagesPublisher or SpotFilteredHandDepthImagesPublisher to filter depth images by max depth threshold
run_object_detection_publisher: run the SpotOpenVocObjectDetectorPublisher with OWLVIT to detect multi-class objects and convert 2D pixels to 3D coordinates
run_decompress_publisher: run the SpotDecompressingRawImagesPublisher to decompress ByteMultiArray messages back into head depth, hand depth, and hand RGB images
